name: gcf-wasm
description: Development workspace for gcf-wasm (the hand-written WebAssembly GCF codec and the @felixdrp/gcf-wasm npm package). Not published itself.

scripts.//: Comments use "//<script>" keys (plain JSON: works with Bun, Node and npm). Requires bun; bench:node and test:perf also run node. The differential tests against the Zig reference need the reference/gcf-zig submodule (git submodule update --init) and zig 0.17+.
scripts.//build: Compile dist/gcf.wasm (the codec, src/wat/*.wat, without debug names: what npm and releases ship), dist/gcf.debug.wasm (the same with function names), dist/gcf_simd.wasm + dist/gcf_simd.relaxed.wasm (structural indexer, src/gcf_simd.wat) via wabt, and dist/gcf_zig.wasm (the Zig reference build from reference/gcf-zig; skipped with a notice when the submodule or zig is missing, an error with GCF_REQUIRE_ORACLE=1).
scripts.//build:npm: Build the npm package (@felixdrp/gcf-wasm) into npm/: bundled JS, CLI, type declarations, dist/gcf.wasm, LICENSE, NOTICE.
scripts.//pack:npm: Build and pack the npm package into npm/*.tgz without publishing (inspect before `npm publish --access public`).
scripts.pack:npm: bun run build:npm && cd npm && bun pm pack
scripts.//test: Build, then run every test in test/ against dist/gcf.wasm: conformance fixtures, encoder properties, bytes API and lazy decoding, tutorial sync, FUTURE_OPTION A performance thresholds in Bun/JSC and Node/V8, and the byte-for-byte differential tests against the Zig reference (skipped without dist/gcf_zig.wasm). Performance thresholds assume an otherwise idle machine.
scripts.//test:conformance: Build, then run only the Blackwell conformance suite, SIMD cross-checks, host API and robustness tests.
scripts.//test:encoder: Build, then run the encoder property tests (round trips, JS vs wasm quoting, largeInt, streaming, deltas).
scripts.//test:boundary: Build, then run the bytes-in/bytes-out API and lazy-decoding tests (docs/JS_WASM_BOUNDARY.md).
scripts.//test:perf: Build, then run only the performance thresholds (>= 1.5 GB/s, <= 3 cycles/block, < 2% jitter). GCF_PERF_ASSERT=0 makes it report-only.
scripts.//test:oracle: Build (the Zig reference is required), then compare the codec with the Zig reference build: byte-for-byte differential tests of every export (test/gcf_wat.test.ts), and the conformance, encoder, boundary and memory suites run against dist/gcf_zig.wasm as well (GCF_WASM=gcf_zig.wasm).
scripts.test:oracle: GCF_REQUIRE_ORACLE=1 bun scripts/build.ts && GCF_REQUIRE_ORACLE=1 bun test test/gcf_wat.test.ts && GCF_WASM=gcf_zig.wasm bun test test/gcf_compliance.test.ts test/gcf_encoder.test.ts test/gcf_boundary.test.ts test/gcf_memory.test.ts
scripts.//tutorial: Regenerate the example blocks of docs/TUTORIAL.md from examples/*.ts and their real output (--check verifies instead).
scripts.//gcf: Command-line codec: bun run gcf -- encode|decode|stats [file].
scripts.//bench: Build, then benchmark against the Blackwell TypeScript SDK under Bun (JavaScriptCore): decoding, encoding, bytes-to-bytes pipelines and lazy access. Results: bench/results/bun.json (GCF_WASM=gcf_zig.wasm: the Zig reference, bench/results/bun-zig.json).
scripts.//bench:node: Same benchmark under Node (V8): bundles bench/run.ts with Bun into bench/dist/run.mjs, then runs it with node. Results: bench/results/node.json.
scripts.bench:node: bun scripts/build.ts && bun build bench/run.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=bench/dist/run.mjs && node bench/dist/run.mjs
scripts.//bench:wat: Build, then compare the codec with the Zig reference build (speed under Bun and Node, binary size; also the equal-scope Zig builds from `zig build wasm-generic`). Needs the submodule and zig. Results: bench/results/wat-vs-zig-*.json, summary in docs/WAT_CODEC.md.
scripts.bench:wat: GCF_REQUIRE_ORACLE=1 bun scripts/build.ts && (cd reference/gcf-zig && zig build wasm-generic) && bun bench/wat_vs_zig.ts && bun build bench/wat_vs_zig.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=bench/dist/wat_vs_zig.mjs && node bench/dist/wat_vs_zig.mjs
